verdict.rationale: Qodo runs autonomously in the background on pull requests. Once connected, it reviews every PR automatically, and reviews can be set to trigger automatically. It also auto-publishes risk labels and enforces standards across repositories without manual intervention, all configurable via the portal or .pr_agent.toml. However, this automation is limited to PR-review events rather than user-defined background automations. missing for 10: general-purpose user-defined automations (custom triggers, schedules, arbitrary actions beyond PR review), documentation of background agent workflows outside the PR lifecycle, independent hands-on corroboration.
